description:
Get details of project specified by id or key in Zephyr

**Toolset:** Projects

**Parameters:**
- projectIdOrKey (string) *required*: The Zephyr project ID or Jira project key

**Examples:**
1. Get the project with id 1
```json
{
  "projectIdOrKey": "1"
}
```
Expected Output: The project with its details

2. Get the project with key 'PROJ'
```json
{
  "projectIdOrKey": "PROJ"
}
```
Expected Output: The project with its details

projectIdOrKey.description: The Zephyr project ID or Jira project key

name: zephyr_get_project

enabled.description: Indicates whether the project has Zephyr enabled on it.

id.description: The ID of the project in Zephyr.

jiraProjectId.description: The ID of the project in Jira.

title: Zephyr: Get Project
